profile.headline:
Building products.
Engineering systems.
Exploring AI & ML.
profile.intro: I'm Chukwudubem, founder of NIPPYSKY. I build web and mobile products, with experience supporting enterprise infrastructure. Now I'm taking that foundation into AI and machine learning.
profile.currentFocus: MSc in AI & Automation at University West. Building, experimenting, and learning in public.
profile.availability: Open to software engineering and AI/ML opportunities.
profile.bio:
My work has always moved between building things and understanding how they run. From electrical and electronic engineering to software, enterprise infrastructure, and founding NIPPYSKY, I've kept following the problems that make me learn.

I've built web and mobile products, worked with product and engineering teams, and supported business-critical Linux, Windows Server and VMware environments. That experience shapes how I think about reliability, user experience, and getting useful software into people's hands.

Today, I'm based in Sweden and studying AI & Automation at University West. I'm developing my Python, machine learning and automation skills through coursework, experiments and projects. I'm looking for opportunities where I can contribute my software and systems experience while growing in AI/ML.

work.title: Akù
